gifts.name: Hero of Balance (Kyurem)

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action: for 3 rounds all within 5m have Combat Stages locked to zero.
gifts.name: The Empty Tao (Kyurem)

gifts.effect: You gain the Winter's Kiss Ability.
gifts.name: Winter's Kiss (Kyurem)

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Glaciate.
gifts.name: Glaciate (Kyurem)
gifts.prereq: All Kyurem & shared Tao Trio Major Gifts

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Freeze Shock.
gifts.name: Freeze Shock (Kyurem)
gifts.prereq: All Kyurem & shared Tao Trio Major Gifts, Minor Gift - Hero of Ideals

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Ice Burn.
gifts.name: Ice Burn (Kyurem)
gifts.prereq: All Kyurem & shared Tao Trio Major Gifts, Minor Gift - Hero of Truth

gifts.effect: Daily x3 Standard Action: pool your remaining HP with an allied target's and split it as you wish.
gifts.name: Shared Mortality

gifts.effect: You intuitively tell when a creature is below 50% of its maximum HP, and whether it is Heavily Injured.
gifts.name: Sense of Life (Xerneas)

gifts.effect: On an Extended Rest, you and nearby Trainers/Pokémon are treated as if you spent the night at a Poké Center.  [B&D 1.05 — the Divines update prints Sense of Life instead.]
gifts.name: Rejuvenating Aura (Xerneas)

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action: a target is cured of all Injuries and Status Effects.
gifts.name: Bounty of Life (Xerneas)

gifts.effect: You gain the Fairy Aura Ability.
gifts.name: Fairy Aura (Xerneas)

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Geomancy.
gifts.name: Geomancy (Xerneas)
gifts.prereq: All Xerneas Major Gifts & shared Mortality Duo Gifts

gifts.effect: Injuries you inflict heal only at a Poké Center, and only one per day.
gifts.name: Death Dealer (Yveltal)

gifts.effect: Daily x3 Free Action when you inflict Injuries: inflict one additional Injury.
gifts.name: Touch of the Flayed One (Yveltal)

gifts.effect: You gain the Dark Aura Ability.
gifts.name: Dark Aura (Yveltal)
gifts.prereq: Major Gift - Touch of the Flayed One

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Oblivion Wing.
gifts.name: Oblivion Wing (Yveltal)
gifts.prereq: All Yveltal Major Gifts & shared Mortality Duo Gifts

gifts.effect: Scene Extended Action: sense whether Legendary Pokémon are in the vicinity and roughly where.
gifts.name: World Serpent's Embrace

gifts.effect: Daily x3 Free Action when Trapped/Slowed/Tripped/Grappled: evade that Status/Maneuver.
gifts.name: He Who Cannot Be Shackled

gifts.effect: You gain the Godslayer Feature (or another Feature if you already have it); Godslayer's AC becomes 8 and no feedback.
gifts.name: God Crusher

gifts.effect: You occasionally receive a vision of a powerful foe, or of an event yet to pass, that could seriously damage the world or disrupt the fabric between dimensions.
gifts.name: World's Guardian

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action on a target within 10m: you gain +2 accuracy and +5 damage against it, and while it is more than 5m away at the start of your turn you may Teleport to any space adjacent to it as a Shift Action. Lasts until the end of the Scene.
gifts.name: Serpent's Prey

gifts.effect: Daily Free Action when you fall to 0 or fewer HP: you are instead set to 1 HP (and to 9 Injuries if the triggering effect brought you to 10 or more). Gain Temporary HP equal to half your Maximum HP, and ignore the effects of being Heavily Injured until you no longer have Temporary HP.
gifts.name: Cells of the World

gifts.effect: You gain the Aura Break Ability.
gifts.name: Aura Break

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Land's Wrath.
gifts.name: Land's Wrath

gifts.effect: You gain a bonus to any roll required for Combat Maneuvers equal to half your Intuition Rank.
gifts.name: Experience of Ages

gifts.effect: Daily Swift Action: gain +1 CS to a stat of your choice, plus either +2 Critical Hit range or 5 DR, until the end of the Scene or until you Faint. Until it ends, enemies adjacent to you take −2 accuracy on any attack that doesn't include you as a target.
gifts.name: Crowned Aura

gifts.effect: Scene Free Action when you hit with an attack: after it resolves, one target hit is one step more vulnerable to all damage for one full round.
gifts.name: Vorpal Strike (Zacian)

gifts.effect: You gain the Intrepid Sword Ability.
gifts.name: Intrepid Sword (Zacian)

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Behemoth Blade.
gifts.name: Behemoth Blade (Zacian)
gifts.prereq: All Zacian Major Gifts, Major Gift - Crowned Aura

gifts.effect: Scene Free Action, Interrupt, when a Trainer or Pokémon within 3m is hit by an attack: for one full round the triggering creature, and every other ally hit by that attack, resists all damage one step further.
gifts.name: Aegis Guard (Zamazenta)

gifts.effect: You gain the Dauntless Shield Ability.
gifts.name: Dauntless Shield (Zamazenta)

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Behemoth Bash.
gifts.name: Behemoth Bash (Zamazenta)
gifts.prereq: All Zamazenta Major Gifts, Major Gift - Crowned Aura

gifts.effect: +3 to Perception and Intuition when assessing another's capabilities.
gifts.name: Eye of Judgement

gifts.effect: Daily Swift Action on a foe within 10m: you and the target may each teleport adjacent to the other as a Shift Action, and each take −3 accuracy against any character besides the other. Lasts until the end of the Scene or until either of you Faints; the first of you to Faint grants the other +2 CS in a stat of their choice.
gifts.name: Prove Your Worth

gifts.effect: Daily Swift Action: until the end of the Scene you gain 5 DR and your Overland rises to 8 if lower. You may end it early as a Free Action Reaction when hit by an attack, Freezing the attacker for one full round.
gifts.name: Frigid Armor (Glastrier)

gifts.effect: You gain the Chilling Neigh Ability.
gifts.name: Chilling Neigh (Glastrier)

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Glacial Lance.
gifts.name: Glacial Lance (Glastrier)
gifts.prereq: All Glastrier Major Gifts, Major Gift - Prove Your Worth

gifts.effect: Daily Swift Action: until the end of the Scene you gain the Blindsense Capability and +2 accuracy. You may end it early as a Free Action when you hit with an attack, Confusing the target and leaving it Slowed until the Confusion is cured.
gifts.name: Soul Sight (Spectrier)

gifts.effect: You gain the Grim Neigh Ability.
gifts.name: Grim Neigh (Spectrier)

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Astral Barrage.
gifts.name: Astral Barrage (Spectrier)
gifts.prereq: All Spectrier Major Gifts, Major Gift - Prove Your Worth

gifts.effect: You may use Command instead of the usual Skill for Grapple, Push and Disarm Maneuvers, and for any check to mount or remain mounted.
gifts.name: Regal Right

gifts.effect: Scene Swift Action: until the end of your next turn, foes within 8m take −3 accuracy against any character other than you. Each attack an affected character makes against you before it expires gives you +1 CS in a stat of your choice (chosen separately for each attack).
gifts.name: Witness Me

gifts.effect: Daily Shift Action: a Burst 5 around you springs to life with vibrant plants, whatever the terrain or urban structures. The area counts as Slow and Rough terrain for enemies, even those with Naturewalk, and you may place up to 4 Medium Trees up to 4m high anywhere in the zone as Blocking Terrain. At the end of the Scene the plants remain as ordinary forested terrain.
gifts.name: Revitalize the Land

gifts.effect: You gain the As One Capability, though you do not gain Types from using it.
gifts.name: As One

gifts.effect: You gain the Splendorous Rider Ability.
gifts.name: Splendorous Rider

gifts.effect: Telepathically communicate with your bound Mewtwo at any distance; gain the Soulbound Edge.
gifts.name: Twin Souls

gifts.effect: Gain the Telepath or Telekinetic Capability (or the Godslayer Feature if you have both).
gifts.name: Expanded Horizons

gifts.effect: Daily Extended Action (with your Mewtwo nearby): Focus check as Telepath to instill a thought/action into a target's mind.
gifts.name: Mental Suggestion

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Psystrike.
gifts.name: Psystrike
gifts.prereq: Twin Souls, Expanded Horizons, Mental Suggestion

gifts.effect: You may add your Mind Modifier instead of your Body Modifier to Intimidate Checks, and gain +2 to Intimidate Checks against Pokémon.
gifts.name: Alien Countenance

gifts.effect: You gain the Amorphous Capability.
gifts.name: Amorphous

gifts.effect: You gain the Phasing Capability.
gifts.name: Phasing

gifts.effect: You gain the Mindlock Capability.
gifts.name: Mindlock

gifts.effect: Static: you may always treat the distance between you and any Trainer or Pokémon as one metre greater or one metre less, as you choose, for range and travel — the value is fixed when an action is announced and cannot be changed afterwards, so it cannot be used to dodge melee. Scene Standard Action, Interrupt: once per Scene, when hit by a single-target attack, it instead hits a target of your choice in an adjacent square.
gifts.name: Hypergeometry

gifts.effect: You intuitively sense the presence of those carrying non-MissingNo Gifts, though never who they are. The more Gifts someone has the further off you sense them, but never beyond about 15 metres.
gifts.name: Detect Heretic

gifts.effect: You gain the Giftsapper Feature regardless of its prerequisites, and are not bound by its requirement to have no Gifts. Giftsapper gained this way has no effect on Gifts granted by MissingNo.
gifts.name: Knight of the Fallen God

gifts.effect: X AP Standard Action on a Trainer or Pokémon within 6m: for each AP spent (max 3) roll 1d20 — the target becomes one step weaker against a Type determined as if rolling for the Type of Hidden Power. Lasts until the end of the encounter, even if the target is recalled.
gifts.name: Corrupt Existence

gifts.effect: Scene Standard Action, Range: Field. For 5 rounds the Field becomes Bugged: all combatants are treated as having had Heal Block applied to them, everyone becomes Typeless and all effects deal only Typeless damage, and at the beginning of each round every combatant other than you loses 1/16th of their maximum HP.
gifts.name: Storm of the Fallen God

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action on a Legendary Pokémon within 10m: dispel one of the target's Legendary Auras for the rest of the encounter.
gifts.name: Slayer of the False Gods

gifts.effect: +3 to Technology Education Checks made to destroy, sabotage or otherwise disrupt modern electronics.
gifts.kind: gift:Minor · Outsider — MissingNo (God of Network Security)
gifts.name: Intuitive Sabotage

gifts.effect: 2 AP Standard Action, Interrupt, targeting one instance of electronic communication you are aware of nearby — an email being typed at the next computer, a text being sent. You may view and edit the message before it is transmitted, with the sender none the wiser. On extended communication such as a phone or video call, it covers one minute per activation.
gifts.kind: gift:Major · Outsider — MissingNo (God of Network Security)
gifts.name: Glitch Message

gifts.effect: Daily/15/30/45 Standard Action: for the next ten minutes all wireless communication within 10m of you fails — radios stop receiving, WiFi shuts down, and cell signals cannot reach phones.
gifts.kind: gift:Major · Outsider — MissingNo (God of Network Security)
gifts.name: Dead Zone

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action: for the next 5 minutes you see networks as a visual overlay when looking at people communicating electronically — lines of light arcing from device to device.
gifts.kind: gift:Major · Outsider — MissingNo (God of Network Security)
gifts.name: See the Wired

gifts.effect: You gain the Wired Capability. Electronics you occupy gradually degrade and begin to malfunction over time.
gifts.kind: gift:Pact · Outsider — MissingNo (God of Network Security)
gifts.name: Ghost in The Machine

gifts.effect: +3 to Occult Education Checks made to identify the purpose of raw materials and reagents.
gifts.name: Core of the Sun (Solgaleo)

gifts.effect: You gain the Glow and Darkvision Capabilities.
gifts.name: Pierce the Darkness (Solgaleo)
gifts.prereq: Minor Gift - Core of the Sun

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action: until the end of the Scene (or until you end it as a Free Action) every space in a Burst 3 around you is lit by a bright light, and all foes in the burst take −3 evasion.
gifts.name: Aura of Light (Solgaleo)

gifts.effect: You gain the Full Metal Body Ability.
gifts.name: Full Metal Body (Solgaleo)
gifts.prereq: Minor Gift - Core of the Sun

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Sunsteel Strike.
gifts.name: Sunsteel Strike (Solgaleo)

gifts.effect: +3 to Survival Checks made to navigate at night.
gifts.name: Heart of the Moon (Lunala)

gifts.effect: You gain the Stealth and Darkvision Capabilities.
gifts.name: Embrace the Night (Lunala)
gifts.prereq: Minor Gift - Heart of the Moon

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action: until the end of the Scene (or until you end it as a Free Action) every space in a Burst 3 around you is darkened by a clinging shadow, and all foes in the burst take −3 accuracy.
gifts.name: Shroud of Darkness (Lunala)

gifts.effect: You gain the Shadow Shield Ability.
gifts.name: Shadow Shield (Lunala)
gifts.prereq: Minor Gift - Heart of the Moon

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Moongeist Beam.
gifts.name: Moongeist Beam (Lunala)

gifts.effect: Reroll all 1s on Focus and Perception Checks.
gifts.name: Prism Shard

gifts.effect: You gain the Darkvision and Mindlock Capabilities.
gifts.name: Hunter in the Darkness

gifts.effect: You gain the Sunglow or Starlight Ability.
gifts.name: Light Devourer

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action: for the next five minutes all light within 10m of you is extinguished, leaving a black void. It is Blocking Terrain for line of sight to anyone without Darkvision or Blindsight, and anyone without either suffers Total Blindness inside it. The Glow Capability and Illuminate Ability are disabled within, and Moves granting Glow may not be used. While it is active you may not take Standard Actions; ending it is a Swift Action.
gifts.name: Absolute Dark

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Photon Geyser.
gifts.name: Photon Geyser

gifts.effect: +2 to all Checks dealing with extradimensional creatures, objects and events, and −4 to Stealth Checks against them.
gifts.name: Faller
gifts.prereq: GM Permission, exposure to Ultra Space or another similar phenomenon

gifts.effect: You gain the Tracker Capability, usable only against creatures, objects and phenomena not native to your current dimension (or recently touched by such). You also know the general direction of the nearest portal or rift home, if one exists.
gifts.name: Dimension Sense

gifts.effect: Drain 2 AP Extended Action when you finish an Extended Rest: choose Chilled, Darkvision, Gilled, Glow, Heater, Magnetic, Mindlock, Naturewalk in a terrain of your choice, or Wallclimber — plus Gravitic Tolerance (1-3) or (2-4) if the campaign uses them. You gain that Capability until the end of your next Extended Rest. May be triggered several times from one Rest.
gifts.name: Dimensional Adaptation

gifts.effect: You gain the Beast Boost Ability.
gifts.name: Beast Boost
gifts.prereq: Major Gift - Dimension Sense, Major Gift - Dimensional Adaptation

gifts.effect: Your Maximum HP can never be reduced below 50% of its full value.
gifts.name: Eternal Presence

gifts.effect: You gain the Poison Touch Ability.
gifts.name: Corrosive Presence

gifts.effect: Daily Standard Action on a creature within 5m: roll an AC 2 Status Attack. On a miss nothing happens and the Feature is not expended. On a hit the target loses 10 HP for each Combat Stage it has, then loses every Combat Stage not gained from Legendary Auras — and you regain 5 HP for each Combat Stage lost this way.
gifts.name: Energy Siphon

gifts.effect: Daily Swift Action: take X Injuries, where X is 1 to 9. Your size grows into a Burst 1 around you if there is room, pushing creatures to the nearest unoccupied space. Until the end of the Scene you gain +2X to all Damage Rolls and 5X Temporary Hit Points.
gifts.name: Dynamax

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Dynamax Cannon.
gifts.name: Dynamax Cannon

gifts.effect: +3 bonus to Occult Education and Medicine Education Checks concerning souls, spirits, death, and the line between the living and the dead. You can sense whether a creature within 10m has died within the last hour. (Bond deepens at Vulpoxen Lv 5.)
gifts.name: Grafted Soul

gifts.effect: Daily Extended Action, targeting the remains, ashes, or a treasured possession of a creature that has died: you and Vulpoxen kindle a cold flame and commune with the departed spirit, asking questions it answers truthfully to the best of what it knew in life. A spirit gone longer than a year is faint and manages only one answer. (Vulpoxen Lv 20.)
gifts.name: Ashen Séance

gifts.effect: You gain the Pyre of Grief Ability (heal a Tick of HP + a stacking-capped +5 to your next Damage Roll whenever anything faints within 5m). (Vulpoxen Lv 30 — Nightmare Aura wakes.)
gifts.name: Emberwake

gifts.effect: Scene x2, Standard Action, AC 6, Range 4m 1 Target: the target falls Asleep and immediately gains Bad Sleep. (Vulpoxen Lv 50 — Death Aura opens.)
gifts.name: Coma Light

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Rekindling — a Fire attack that, on a killing blow, revives a fainted ally as a Ghost-Type revenant. (Vulpoxen Lv 75 — full god.)
gifts.name: Rekindling

gifts.effect: By observing a Pokémon, Trainer, structure, or object, you intuitively know its frailest points, and you can always tell when a living thing bears you or your allies genuine hostility. +3 to any Check made to break, damage, or exploit a weakness in a creature's defenses.
gifts.name: Sense of Ruin

gifts.effect: Whenever a foe hits you with a Move, you gain +1 Attack Combat Stage (once per round, lasting until end of Scene). You are also immune to Infatuation.
gifts.name: Reviled

gifts.effect: You are immune to the ambient cold of frozen and high-altitude regions, never slip on or sink into snow and ice, and gain the Freezer and Naturewalk (Tundra) Capabilities.
gifts.name: Spiteful Frost

gifts.effect: Scene x2 - Trigger: You make a Struggle Attack with an equipped weapon. Effect: That Struggle Attack deals Dark Type damage and gains +3 to its Damage Base.
gifts.name: Blade of Hate

gifts.effect: You gain the Sword of Ruin Ability.
gifts.name: Sword of Ruin

gifts.effect: You learn the Move Ruination.
gifts.name: Ruination

gifts.effect:
Static: You sense the presence of and can identify those with Gifts coming from your Patron's subservient Pokémon. You know which Gifts someone has from your Patron's subservient Pokémon by looking at them. 2 AP: Target Trainer within 8 meters with a Gift from your Patron's subservient Pokémon has the Gift of your choice from that subservient Pokémon disabled for the next ten minutes.
Hierarchies — Lugia: Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres · Ho-Oh: Entei, Raikou, Suicune · Rayquaza: Groudon, Kyogre · Landorus: Thundurus, Tornadus · Regigigas: Regice, Regirock, Registeel · Cobalion: Virizion, Terrakion, Keldeo.
gifts.name: Gift of Command
gifts.prereq: One Major Gift from your Patron

gifts.effect:
Static: You know when there are people, Pokémon, or objects that would appear differently to you through Symbolsight within an area about the size of a small town. You do not know their location, number, or distance from you, only that there is at least one within range of your sense. 1 AP: For the next ten minutes, you see the world through the lens of Symbolsight. You may end this effect early as a Free Action.
Symbolsight shows the symbolic ties between mortal and divine — a Trainer Gifted by Cobalion might appear carrying three swords under a hanging scale of justice. It is a good Feature for a PC otherwise uninvolved in the Gift plot-line.
gifts.freq: Static | 1 AP - Standard Action · Target: Self
gifts.name: Symbolsight

gifts.effect:
You may attempt to shatter one of the target's Legendary Auras. The AC of this action is 10. If you successfully disabled the Aura but rolled a 10-15, the feedback from the action gives you an Injury.
Only the Higher Pantheon, some Outsiders, and Arceus himself can bestow this one.
gifts.freq: Standard Action — EOT · Target: A Legendary Pokémon
gifts.name: Godslayer

gifts.effect:
As long as Giftsapper's user is conscious, all Trainers within 10 meters must make a Focus Check with DC equal to three times the highest Skill Rank of Giftsapper's user between Focus, Intimidate, or Command in order to activate their Gifts. This Check is made each time a Trainer attempts to use an activated Gift, and a failure means neither any resources such as AP nor the frequency of the Gift is expended. For Gifts with Static or ongoing effects, the Check is made each turn, and a failure ends the effect for that turn.
Giftsapper's user may NEVER gain Gifts.
gifts.name: Giftsapper

gifts.effect: Your connection with one of your Patrons has reached such a point that even you are capable of performing the miracles they are renowned and worshiped for. Expending a use of Messiah allows you to perform such a miracle — for example, in a Region where Shaymin is known to restore withered forests to their former glory, a Messiah of Shaymin might cause a forest to rapidly recover from a wildfire. Such acts are usually, but not always, noticeably supernatural and divine.
gifts.name: Messiah

gifts.effect: You acquire a Blessing marked Rank 1 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.
gifts.name: In My Name (Rank 1)

gifts.effect: You acquire a Blessing marked Rank 2 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.
gifts.name: In My Name (Rank 2)
gifts.prereq: Completed a task on behalf of your Patron, GM Permission

gifts.effect: You acquire a Blessing marked Rank 3 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.
gifts.name: In My Name (Rank 3)

gifts.effect: You acquire a Blessing marked Rank 4 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing. If your Patron does not have a Pact Gift, you instead require all their Major Gifts to attain Rank 4.
gifts.name: In My Name (Rank 4)

gifts.effect: Choose a Rank 1 Blessing. You gain this Blessing in the form of a Sign. Signs store the energy of the Divine and may be activated as a Swift Action. Signs can be used once per Scene, and cost 1 AP to activate.
gifts.name: Signer

gifts.effect: You acquire two Blessings in the form of Signs, marked Rank 1 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.
gifts.name: Sign Mastery (Rank 1)

gifts.effect: You acquire two Blessings in the form of Signs, marked Rank 2 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.
gifts.name: Sign Mastery (Rank 2)

gifts.effect: You acquire two Blessings in the form of Signs, marked Rank 3 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.
gifts.name: Sign Mastery (Rank 3)
gifts.prereq: All your Patron's Major Gifts, GM Permission

gifts.effect: You acquire two Blessings in the form of Signs, marked Rank 4 or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing. If your Patron does not have a Pact Gift, you instead require all their Major Gifts to attain Rank 4.
gifts.name: Sign Mastery (Rank 4)

gifts.effect:
Your human form is now considered your Avatar, and you gain a second set of stats for your Pokémon form. This form is that of the Legendary you usurped, starts at Level 1 with the Nature and Abilities of your choice, and may gain Experience as if it were a Pokémon you owned. Switching between your human form and this one takes a Standard Action. Usurpers cannot receive Gifts or Blessings from other Legendaries, as they are divinity themselves now. Any Touched, Branded, Messiah and Signer Edges and Features you possessed up until this point are refunded.
Damage is SHARED: when an Usurper takes damage in one form, both forms lose HP equal to the final amount dealt. Knocked Out in one form but not the other, they default to the still-conscious one. Your Legendary Form also has access to every Capability, Ability and Move your Avatar does.
gifts.name: Usurper
gifts.prereq: You have slain a God and through occult ritual or technology have absorbed its essence.

gifts.effect: You gain access to your Legendary Form's Abilities while in your Avatar form.
gifts.name: Shared Strengths (Rank 1)

gifts.effect: You gain your Legendary Form's Types while in your Avatar form.
gifts.name: Shared Strengths (Rank 2)
gifts.prereq: Shared Strengths Rank 1, Pokémon Form Level 35

gifts.effect:
You gain one of the Domains, and its corresponding Legendary Aura, associated with your Legendary Form.
Assign the Domain on the Legendary Form's own sheet — it is a Pokémon, so the Legendary Aura machinery already applies the +2 Combat Stages and the three-active cap.
gifts.name: True Power (1st)
gifts.prereq: Shared Strengths Rank 2, Pokémon Form Level 40

gifts.effect: You gain access to your Legendary Form's Move List while in your Avatar form.
gifts.name: Shared Strengths (Rank 3)

gifts.effect: A second Domain, and its corresponding Legendary Aura, from your Legendary Form.
gifts.name: True Power (2nd)

gifts.effect: You gift your target with a Blessing of your own. Whether this makes them Touched, a Signer, or Branded is at your discretion. The Blessings need not be the ones listed for your Legendary Form — they may be of your own creation, at your GM's discretion.
gifts.freq: One Time Use · Target: A Trainer
gifts.name: Gift of Power

gifts.effect: A third Domain, and its corresponding Legendary Aura, from your Legendary Form.
gifts.name: True Power (3rd)

gifts.effect: Your sense of smell is enhanced, giving you the ability to track living things — as well as the deceased — with little effort. However, you will forever smell of a corpse yourself.
gifts.name: Carrion Scent

gifts.effect: You gain a literal Brand: an unsettling tattoo on a noticeable part of your body, or a deformation such as one of your eyes becoming visibly cursed. This Brand lets the one who placed it communicate with you and locate you at any time, and they may even have advice or an offer of help on occasion.
gifts.name: Mark of the Damned

gifts.effect: You have a permanent pain in your wrists and feet, and whenever you have more than 3 Injuries you bleed from those points. This bleeding will not let you recover from those Injuries without extensive medical care and rest. However, you no longer take Max HP penalties from Injuries.
gifts.name: Stigmata

gifts.effect: You completely lose your Aura and gain the Mindlock Capability. This makes you untraceable to Aura Readers, but you also cannot receive Aura Pulse or Telepathic messages at all. If you have a Psychic-related class other than Type Ace, Channeler or Aura Guardian, your Features in those classes are refunded.
gifts.name: Total Solitude

gifts.effect: Your very being becomes warped, taking on aspects of the one who Branded you. You gain the Elemental Types they possess and +4 to Intimidate Checks, but take a -4 penalty on Charm and Guile Checks, as these deformations are unsettling to most people and Pokémon.
gifts.name: Twisted Form

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Static): You gain an extra Dice on Education: Occult checks, as well as any Check dealing with Occult topics or situations.
Signer (Free Action): You may use Ancient Wisdom while making an Education: Occult check to add an additional Two Dice.
gifts.name: Ancient Wisdom

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Scene x3 — Free Action): Your Struggle Attack's Type matches that of your Patron. If your Patron has two Types, choose one.
Signer (Free Action): Your Struggle Attack deals Typeless Damage.
gifts.name: Blessed Strike

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Static): When you take Paragon, choose either Body, Mind or Spirit. You gain +3 to all Skill Checks made with Skills in that group.
Signer (Swift Action): You instead choose one of these Skill Groups and gain a +1 bonus to all Skill Checks under it. This lasts until the end of the Scene. You may choose a different Skill Group each time you activate Paragon.
gifts.name: Paragon

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Daily x3 — Free Action): Choose one of the following: the Target is healed 50% of their HP, or the Target recovers two Injuries that do not count against the Daily Limit.
Signer (Standard Action): The Target heals two ticks of HP, and recovers an Injury.
gifts.name: Spirit Mending

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Static): Choose a Move on your Patron's Level-Up List that matches one of their Types and is either a Damaging Move with a Damage Base of 8 or lower, or a Status Move of a non-Daily Frequency. You learn this Move.
Signer (Swift Action): You instead gain this chosen Move until the end of combat. You may choose a different Move each time you activate this Sign.
gifts.name: Blessed Power

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Daily x3 — Free Action): You may reroll this Skill Check or Accuracy Roll.
Signer (Free Action): You may add +4 to this Skill Check or +2 to this Accuracy Roll.
gifts.name: Luck of the Gods

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Special — one use, plus one per Level 5/10/20/30/40 Milestone reached): Your divine powers allow you to intervene, saving the Target's life. Used in combat as a Free Action Interrupt, they are set to 5 Injuries that heal at half the normal rate and to 50% HP; until the end of combat they have DR equal to their tick value and may not be healed. Used out of combat as an Extended Action, the Target is set to 5 Injuries and 1 HP.
Signer (Free Action): The Target receives no further Injuries after being reduced below 0 HP. If being Knocked Out alone would set them to 10 Injuries, they are instead set to 9 Injuries.
gifts.name: Soul Mending

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Static): Choose two Types your Patron has Resistance or Immunity to. You gain Resistance to these Types.
Signer (Standard Action): Choose a single Type your Patron has Resistance or Immunity to. You gain Resistance to this Type until the end of the Scene. You may choose a different Type each time you use Blessed Resilience.
gifts.name: Blessed Resilience

gifts.effect:
Messiah (Scene — Swift Action): You become aware of any Pacts, Patrons, or Allegiances the Target may have to a Legendary being or any organization. If the Target has a particular weakness (both narrative and mechanical), you become aware of it. You also become aware of any goals or motives the Target might possess at the moment.
Signer (Swift Action): You learn one of the Target's weaknesses (narrative or mechanical). If the Target is aligned to a Legendary or an organization, you become aware of this fact, but not of who or what in particular. You also learn if the Target's motives or goals would harm your Patron or their followers.
gifts.name: Insight of the Great Ones
